# netbox_job (Data Source)

Reads a single NetBox job (`/api/core/jobs/`) by `id`, `name` or filters.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by internal/gen; edit generator/overrides to change, or remove this line to hand-maintain.
data "netbox_job" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

# Lookup by arbitrary API filters:
data "netbox_job" "filtered" {
  filters = [
    { name = "id", value = "123" },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Attributes List) Additional query filters as name/value pairs, e.g. `{ name = "tenant_id", value = "12" }`. Any query parameter of `/api/core/jobs/` is accepted. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--filters))
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `name` (String) Name.

### Read-Only

- `completed` (String) Completed.
- `created` (String) Created.
- `data` (String) Data.
- `display` (String) Display.
- `display_url` (String) Display Url.
- `error` (String) Error.
- `execution_time` (String) Execution Time.
- `interval` (Number) Recurrence interval (in minutes).
- `job_id` (String) Job Id.
- `notifications` (String) Notifications.
- `object` (String) Object.
- `object_id` (Number) Object Id.
- `object_type` (String) Object Type.
- `queue_name` (String) Name of the queue in which this job was enqueued.
- `scheduled` (String) Scheduled.
- `started` (String) Started.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `url` (String) Url.
- `user_id` (Number) User. References `netbox_user`.

<a id="nestedatt--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filters`

Required:

- `name` (String) Query parameter name.
- `value` (String) Query parameter value.
